oracle_packages: internal/gate (config.go presetByName/resolve/normalizeMatchPath/segmentMatch, enforce.go Verdict.action/mapVerdict/isUnsafeMethod, gates.go applyVerdict enf.failclosed.mutating relabel, gate.go modeName)
provenance.command: docker run --rm --network none -e GOTOOLCHAIN=local -e GOPROXY=off -e GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly -e GOMODCACHE=/modcache -e GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache -v <modcache>:/modcache:ro -v <git archive 981d25c go.mod go.sum internal pkg cmd/gate, plus scratch in-package capture tests internal/gate/zz_b1capture_test.go and cmd/gate/zz_b1capture_test.go>:/src:ro -v <fixtures>:/fixtures:ro -v <out>:/out -w /src <image> go test -count=1 -run ^TestB1Capture$ ./internal/gate/ ./cmd/gate/
capture_notes: outputs.cmdGate.routeFiles errors replace the temporary file path with {path}
outputs.cmdGate.attested warnings are sorted by the capture program; Go appends them in map order
outputs.cmdGate.routeFiles[invalid_utf8].ok: encoding/json wrote the invalid byte of the Go map key as U+FFFD
actions.appliedEventType applies the applyVerdict relabel to enf.failclosed.mutating
nondeterministic_in_go: resolve entries with tie=true: two matching prefixes of the winning length select by Go map iteration order
attested[two_attested] without a shared token key: the error names whichever attested prefix Go map iteration visits first
provenance.scope: Frozen oracle outputs for differential parity only; never regenerate to hide drift
